newsitem.title: GERMANY: Militzer & Muench/Pilot Airfreight sign coop deal.
newsitem.headline: Militzer & Muench/Pilot Airfreight sign coop deal.

text.p: German freight forwarder Militzer & Muench GmbH said it has signed an exclusive cooperation agreement with U.S. forwarder Pilot Airfreight.
The deal covered the eight M&M Air Cargo Service GmbH offices in Germany, as well as M&M group offices in eastern Europe and Asia, a company statement said.
Pilot Airfreight, with 1,500 staff in 65 offices, provided a comprehensive coverage of the U.S., it added. - Reuters Air Cargo Newsroom. Tel +44 171 542 7706 Fax+5017
